description: Paid endpoint ($0.02): clustered forced liquidations (10+ same-side fills under 90s apart, notional over a per-coin threshold) in the last 1-24h for BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE and 10 more coins from OKX USDT-SWAP public liquidations: start/end, side, notional, count, largest fill, price move (OKX 1m candles) and severity, plus Hyperliquid large-trader liquidation clusters near price. Optional: hours 1-24, limit 1-50, symbols, side, min_severity. Bad params 400, stale data (>15 min) 503; no charge on errors. Returns x402 requirements + URL. Free sample: https://cryptofeed402.site/samples/liquidations-cascades

side.description: long = longs liquidated, short = shorts liquidated

name: get_liquidation_cascades
title: Liquidation cascades (paid, x402) — $0.02

x402.behavior: Tool returns x402 payment requirements + URL; caller pays over HTTP with own wallet. Charged only on HTTP 200.
